description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'AbstractEphemeralStrategy' which serves as a base for ephemeral connectivity strategies within a messaging persistence framework. The class provides framework methods for handling responses and actions related to connectivity commands, without affecting persistence.

classes.name: AbstractEphemeralStrategy
classes.description: An abstract class providing a base for ephemeral connectivity strategies that do not affect persistence, parameterized by the type of ConnectivityCommand it handles.

methods.name: AbstractEphemeralStrategy
methods.description: Constructor initializing the strategy with a specific command class type.

methods.name: getResponse
methods.description: Abstract method meant to be implemented to generate a response header based on connection state and command headers.

methods.name: getActions
methods.description: Abstract method for retrieving a list of connection actions to execute.

methods.name: doApply
methods.description: Overridden method that constructs a dummy event, generates a response, gets actions, and returns a mutation result encapsulating these for the given command execution context.
